candidate.title: MINCE-Seq
candidate.scope: The single chase-containing MINCE-seq route in the assigned Illumina schematic (card title MINCE-Seq; Mapping In vivo Nascent Chromatin with EdU and sequencing): EdU labeling, thymidine chase, formaldehyde crosslinking, click attachment of biotin, the combined sonication/MNase block, streptavidin capture and DNA extraction. The graph preserves the drawn protein-bearing particles at capture and the terminal DNA product. Targeted primary full-text inspection resolves a consequential implementation difference: published MINCE-seq purifies DNA before biotinylated-DNA capture, with further recovery afterward; explicit corrections qualify the affected states and interfaces. Polymerase and newly formed nucleosomes supply biological context. No alternative assay, library-preparation implementation or sequencing operation is depicted. The registry supplies catalogue text, metadata and an abstract-only paper snapshot; independently retrieved full-text evidence is distinguished by its locator.
